nodes.name: spi_isolation
nodes.description: Two ISO7721 devices (U4, U5) provide four isolated digital channels for the SPI link. Primary‑side powered by VCC_3V3, isolated‑side powered by ISO_3V3. Channel mapping: SCK, CS, MOSI are MCU‑to‑ADC outputs on primary side; MISO is ADC‑to‑MCU input on primary side. Corresponding isolated‑side ports reverse direction.
Dual-channel digital isolator
